note: hand-written before any round-5 extractor code ran, by reading the Go (the fixture is read, not run). Each case is a module under this directory. An rpc entry is a state string or an object of the facts compared exactly (state, codes, unread = a grpc_code_not_literal item, auth, tables, writes as table:op, custom_options).

main.why: Ptr: pointer return of the generated descriptor; Copy: value copy, modified, returned as &d; Alias: a copy of Template with ServiceName assigned a literal, so Alias is registered and Template is not; Absent: never registered

namedyn.why: a copy whose ServiceName is read from the environment is never taken as the original's: Dyn is unread, and (D1.3) so is the declared service nothing else registers

methods.why: Rng/Apd: Methods rebuilt by ranging over the original (index and append forms) keep the generated set; Lit: a literal of one method serves only Get; Opaque: Methods filtered through a function is not a literal set

wrapper.why: the wrapper of Eq's descriptor copy translates domain errors through codeFor (NotFound, InvalidArgument); Raw is registered plainly and the same sentinel errors stay plain (UNKNOWN): the translation is for the wrapped service only
